scope: All original servo mounts and inter-part joint interfaces, not only screw-hole centers
must_preserve: Servo pocket/seat internal width and depth
Separation of paired supporting plates around each servo
Local connector/tab/slot widths and engagement dimensions
Screw bearing thickness and original fastener grip stack
Joint axis locations within each local assembly and existing alignment
Servo horn, bearing/axle seat and original mechanical clearances
allowed_change: EDGE50: outer mount groups translate +/-25 mm without scaling; upper center aperture and two fixed center holes remain; lower core remains except six obsolete inner seats removed above the 3 mm base. White-blue palette.

current_evidence.limitations: no complete assembled sweep or physical fit

release_gates: Compare original vs redesigned local interface sections and plate separation
Place original servo/shaft envelope in correct assembly coordinates
Check full joint travel, cable path and screw access
Physical fit test before complete printing
